messages:
incident-bot: Pager: billing-prod metering variance > 15% vs baseline for last 10m. Possible token-count drift from emitter cluster. Trigger: token_agg.delta_high. @sre-oncall on-call for 8h.

sre-oncall: saw it. can someone confirm customer-facing flags? any overage alerts firing? :eyes:

maya: billing-alerts show ~2.3k overage flags in last 15m, mostly small accounts. attaching quick grep of logs I ran: 
```
$ kubectl logs emitter-prod-3 | tail -n 80 | grep "emit_count_delta" | head
emit_count_delta=+389898
emit_count_delta=+0
emit_count_delta=+0
emit_count_delta=+400120
```

billing-eng: we have delayed usage reports too — some reports arrived 20-40m late and then doubled tokens. suspect a retry storm from the emitter shard.

carla: running healthcheck on emitter-prod-3 now. pinging the kvcache team.

ops-bot: runbook step 1: mark incident P1; step 2: take emitter-prod-3 out of rotation if unhealthy.

sre-oncall: ok please remove from LB if health fails. maya do you have pod metrics?

maya: pod cpu spiked and then OOMKilled recent restart at 1769998400. Logs show kafka acks backlog and emitter replays on reconnect. snippet: 
```
[E] reconnect detected 43 pending acks, replaying 43 batches
[E] reemit batch id=0x7f9 retry=3 tokens=1200
```

liam: created temp route to shard fallback (shard-b) to stop double-emits. applying now: `kubectl annotate svc/emitter route=shard-b-fallback`

billing-eng: note: overage flagging pipeline dedup window is 60s, replays within that window still double-count if they reingest with new event ids. we're seeing new UUIDs.

carla: kvcache team says TTLs expired earlier than expected due to clock skew on node. they pushed a hotfix to sync ntp.

maya: after removing emitter-prod-3 from rotation, overage flags dropped by ~87% in the next 6m. putting numbers: before 2300 flags, after ~310.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress. customer-impact: transient overage flags; delayed usage reconciles may show transient spikes in billing UI.

sre-oncall: good. next steps: 1) leave shard-b fallback for 30m; 2) run reconcile job to dedupe any duplicates; 3) open customer comms if invoices sent.

billing-eng: starting dedupe/recon job: `python tools/recon_dedupe.py --since 1769998200 --dry-run=false --job-id=recon-176999`

liam: recon job queued, ETA 12m. will post results.

carla: reboots and ntp fixed on emitter nodes. we should still scan for missing acks to ensure no data loss.

maya: recon job report: duplicates found ~12k token events across 1.8k accounts. estimated billing impact: 0.6% of daily tokens for affected customers; most will self-correct on next reconciliation, but some invoices generated in last 30m may show spikes.

billing-eng: recommend automatic suppression for invoices in the 1769998200-1769999000 window and schedule a manual audit for any charge > $50 spike.

carla: created ticket BIL-5467 to track suppression + audit. assigned to billing-eng + finance.

sre-oncall: lowering P1 to P2; keeping watch for 45m. please post final recon results and communication draft. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident closed to monitoring state at 1769999130. Follow-ups: BIL-5467 (suppression/audit), postmortem assigned to SRE and Billing.
